purpose: Teach: 下巻/ストローク/ガイダンス/仕手/各論/持ち味/後発/自助

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、捜査記録の下巻も整備されますね
lines.en: I see the police also prepare the second volume of investigation records.
lines.style: Warm, appreciative tone. Speaking as someone familiar with the work. Even cadence, noting specifics with quiet respect for the operational detail.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、緊急時のストローク的判断、頼もしいです
lines.en: The way the police make quick calls in emergencies—that's reassuring.
lines.style: Genuine warmth. Slight upward lift on the compliment. Conversational pace, the tone of someone who has witnessed competence firsthand.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、市民ガイダンスもされますね
lines.en: And you provide guidance for citizens too, I've noticed.
lines.style: Observational, thoughtful. Gentle acknowledgment of work that might go unrecognized. Steady, attentive pacing. Slight warmth on 'noticed'—not distancing.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、株価の仕手戦も捜査されますね
lines.en: The police investigate market manipulation cases as well, don't you.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact statement of scope. Tone neither surprised nor questioning—acknowledging breadth of responsibility. Even delivery, grounded.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、捜査会議で各論を詰められますね
lines.en: I can tell the details get hammered out in your investigation meetings.
lines.style: Respect for rigor. Not rushed. Slight nod of approval in the voice—appreciation for thoroughness without making a show of it.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、それぞれの持ち味を生かしたチーム編成、頼もしいです
lines.en: The way you build teams that bring out each person's strengths—that's something to rely on.
lines.style: Genuine admiration. Warm acknowledgment of human-centered leadership. Conversational, not effusive. Slight emphasis on 'each person'—recognizing the care in it.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、後発で参加する研修もありますね
lines.en: There's training for people who join later too, I understand.
lines.style: Curious, impressed by thoroughness. Light, conversational. The tone of someone learning how a good organization actually works.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、市民の自助努力もご支援されますね
lines.en: And you support citizens in looking after themselves as well.
lines.style: Warm, almost intimate recognition. Shift to closer tone—seeing the fuller picture of care. Gentle landing, genuine.
